'''Futhark''' was a form of [[Writing/Legends|writing]] based on ovals and circles. Used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] as its formal alphabet for [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].

Futhark was the formal written version of the Naboo language, and was derived from the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt]]. Since [[human/Legends|human]] colonists from [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] settled on Naboo, the two scripts remained similar, although with some differences.

The system was used in a regal fashion on Naboo, but it was impractical for everyday use due to the similarity of all characters with each other. [[Futhork/Legends|Futhork]] was developed separately, as a casual, informal writing. The Futhark continued to be used only in formal and military contexts. Features of Naboo [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]], such as the [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]], had Futhark labels on consoles and the hull. However, since ship components were imported from other places, such as [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]], labels and computer displays showed [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], with which the Naboo were familiar.<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}

Random Futhark letters were displayed alongside unfamiliar symbols on either side of a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] menu in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].<ref name="Force Fiction">{{Tales|7|Force Fiction}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Futhark" is derived from the first six letters of the [[Wikipedia:Futhark|Nordic variant runic alphabet]]&mdash;''F'', ''U'', ''Þ'' (a letter representing the dental fricative ''th''), ''A'', ''R'', and ''K''&mdash;used in Scandinavia before the Latin alphabet was introduced there.
<!-- The runes on Thexan's apparel are not futhark, but Tolkien's elven runes
[[File:Thexan_Futhark_Robe.jpg|thumb|180px|right|Futhark script on Thexan's apparel]]
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', actual Nordic futhark runes are embroidered on the robes of [[Thexan]], [[Arcann]], and [[Vaylin]].
-->
